non_commitment_statement_zh: 本模型仅定义概念阶段的计算结构。当前缺少正式工程量、市场询价、采购范围、运营合同、收入记录及公共回流法律机制，不形成预算、估算批复、融资、招商、采购、收入或回流承诺。
non_commitment_statement_en: This model defines a concept-stage calculation structure only. Formal quantities, market quotations, procurement scope, operating contracts, revenue records, and a lawful public-reinvestment mechanism are unavailable. It is not a budget, approved estimate, financing commitment, procurement basis, revenue forecast, or reinvestment commitment.

revenue_no_double_counting_rules: One contract may enter only one primary revenue category.
Taxes, refunds, pass-through payments and unrelated enterprise income must not enter eligible revenue.
Leasing intent, testing applications, media exposure and unsigned cooperation must not be counted as revenue.
Project counts, prices and revenue for all three stages remain unknown/null until validated inputs are available.

public_ai_reinvestment.formula: max(0, commercial_cash_receipts - taxes - refunds - pass_through_payments - unrelated_enterprise_income) * contractually_approved_reinvestment_rate + audited_fixed_contributions
public_ai_reinvestment.statement_zh: 公共回流比例、账户主体、合同条款、允许用途、审计周期和停止条件均未确定，因此本稿不声明任何固定金额或比例。
public_ai_reinvestment.statement_en: The public reinvestment rate, account entity, contract terms, permitted uses, audit cycle, and stop conditions are not confirmed, so this draft declares no fixed amount or percentage.

sensitivity_method.method: Run scenario tables only after quantities, unit costs, contract scopes, revenue-recognition rules and reinvestment terms are validated.

recalculation_triggers: Official redline and key-area polygons are supplied.
Measured quantities and design scope are confirmed.
Market quotations and Beijing price basis are available.
Procurement boundaries and implementing entity are confirmed.
Operator, FTE plan and service contracts are confirmed.
Revenue contracts, invoices, receipts and revenue-recognition rules are available.
Public AI reinvestment legal vehicle, account, permitted uses, audit cycle and stop conditions are approved.
